generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The Executive Engineer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in the form of FDR/ BANK GUARANTEE in the name of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division, Mandya given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the Conditions of Contract
Contractor should carryout additional test required to test the suitability of materials

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost
Contractor should clear all the materials and make clean immediately after completion of the event
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Notification and Kw-4

In case of dispute or difference arising between the Employer and the Contractor relating to any matter arising out of or connected with this agreement it shall be settled through an arbitrator appointed in accordance with the Karnataka Arbitration centre (National/International) rules2012
The bidder shall posses GST registration certificate the necessary document issued by competent authority shall be uploaded
The bidder shall have sufficient labour & material to work round the clock

Within Seven days of the receipt of letter of acceptance the successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer the security deposit of 5% on total amount in FDR Format plus additional security for unbalanced tender

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 at least one work of similar nature Satisfactorily completed in Dasara or State Archaeology or Central Archaeology or Any Heritage sites

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed, as prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work of value not less than Rs.74.47 Lakhs. Certificate issued not below the rank of Exe. Engineer shall be uploaded

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.297.86 Lakhs with UDIN
The bidder should make arrangements of Stage and steps for the requirement to prepare backdrop 5 days earlier to event
The Bidder should make arrangement of all the stage, barricade, seating arrangements before the commence of the Event
The bidder should upload work done satisfactory certificate. Work order will not be accepted
